title: Alweda Alweda Aye Hussain Alweda
body:
Alweda alweda aye hussain alweda
Ham se haqqe aza na ada hosaka
1. Ham shabhi e nabi ali akbare jawaa’n
Barchi ki nok se qalb tera chida
Tera lasha na utha – ali akbar alweda
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Hain roohe qudsi par magar sarfe aza
Har ghadi maa ne bas shah ka matam hai kiya
Bolo sar peetkar- nonehaalo alweda
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Haaye shabbar ke laal haye haidar ke Jamaal
Tera laasha ran mei ho chuka hai pamaal
Aye farwa ke chand- haaye qasim alweda
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Aye mere bawafa tujhpa hum sab ka salaam
Tera parcham liye ayenge jab imam
Hoga parcham tale – tera matam alweda
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Asghare bezabaa’n chid gaya tera gala
Haaye aada ne par tujhko paani na diya
Haaye cheh maah ke sheerkhwaar alweda
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Haaye shahzadiyo tumne kya kya na saha
Chin gayin sar se rida hogayi’n beparda
Dee’n bachaya tumne- bibiyo sad alweda
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Thaame pehlu bibi aati’n thi’n har ghar me
Apne shabbier ka ham se pursa lene
Ab wo rounaq na rahi jaati’n hain syeda
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Hamse haqqe aza na ada hosaka Aur jee bhar ke bhi tera matam na hua
Aye qateelul abara aye shaeede karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Mirza aur meer ki bas yahi hai ilteja
Tera matam kare hashr tak ahle aza
Kehti hain asghari aye hussain alweda
Kalaam : Mirza Aur Kumai
